Signature
No line is bigger than 30 px. A twelve-column grid, the lead sentence placed at column 5 on the top line, the index at column 1 lower down, and one small red square marking the current item. Position is the hierarchy.
Use when
Architects, designers, cultural institutions, consultancies with something precise to say, annual reports.
Turns into slop when
When the grid is invisible and the page is just small text (bland), when the red square becomes a decoration repeated everywhere, or when a giant headline is added "for impact".
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
